req.title: Task id is auto-generated
req.statement: The system shall assign a unique integer id to each new task; client-supplied ids in the payload shall be ignored.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should auto-generate a unique integer ID for each new task, ignoring any client-supplied IDs. This behavior needs to be verified through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_create_task_auto_id_positive
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to create a new task without specifying an ID.
expected: The response payload contains a unique integer ID.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "New Task", "description": "Test task description", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert isinstance(response_data['id'], int)
assert response_data['title'] == "New Task"
assert response_data['description'] == "Test task description"
assert response_data['completed'] is False

tests.name: test_create_task_with_id_negative
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to create a new task with a client-supplied ID.
expected: The client-supplied ID is ignored and a new unique integer ID is generated.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"id": 999, "title": "Task with ID", "description": "This should ignore the ID", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert response_data['id'] != 999
assert isinstance(response_data['id'], int)
assert response_data['title'] == "Task with ID"
assert response_data['description'] == "This should ignore the ID"
assert response_data['completed'] is False

tests.name: test_create_task_boundary_case
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to create a new task with minimal valid data.
expected: The response payload contains a unique integer ID.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "B", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert isinstance(response_data['id'], int)
assert response_data['title'] == "B"
assert response_data['completed'] is False
